cohort: Women admitted for delivery at 92 maternity wards in Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo, in March 2014.
finding: Out-of-pocket payments for delivery varied widely depending on the type of delivery and healthcare facility, with Cesarean sections and deliveries in corporate facilities being the most expensive.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were more expensive than vaginal deliveries, regardless of the type of healthcare facility.
